verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs confirm authorization decisioning infrastructure (ASA delivers transaction metadata via HTTP, Auth Rules can key off MCC/country/currency/risk score, and a dedicated event stream exists for 'digital wallet and merchant tokenization') showing MCC and wallet-related context flow into decisions, but the pack never documents merchant name enrichment, enhanced merchant data fields, entry-mode details, partial-approval, or incremental-auth signals specifically. missing for 10: explicit merchant name/enhanced merchant data fields, entry-mode detail schema, partial-approval signal documentation, incremental-auth signal documentation.
